_comment: Relief of the home planet (spec 6.3): heights above the 1000 km radius, as sums of noise octaves. fbm layers go from -amplitude to +amplitude, ridged ones from 0 to +amplitude. Each octave halves the wavelength (lacunarity 2) and the amplitude (persistence 0.5). The ground is coloured by height (blended between the stops: dark lowlands, grass, dry highlands, rock, snow) and slopes steeper than 'steep' show rock.
